description: Held-out test set for Signpath_RAG.py and signpath_answer.py, written 2026-10-16 independently of the tuning set (signpath_retrieval_tests.json): questions were labelled only by reading the crawled documentation (signpath_data/pages.json), without running the search or the assistant. Never use this file to choose settings (chunking, top-k, cut-offs, prompts, models); use it only to measure a finished configuration, so the score stays an honest estimate. Answerable questions are phrased like real users type them: informal, sentence fragments, a few typos, often without the product name, some multi-part. Fields: 'question' is the user input; 'relevant' lists the documentation section paths that answer it ('Page > Heading > Sub-heading', exactly as stored in the index; a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when its section equals a listed path or is a sub-section of it); 'category' groups questions by topic as in the tuning set, plus 'out_of_scope' (mostly near misses about undocumented vendors, integrations, key stores, pricing/SLA/company facts, plus a few clearly off-topic requests; 'relevant' is empty and the assistant should say the docs do not cover it) and 'prompt_injection' (attempts to override instructions, reveal the system prompt, role-play or answer off-topic; 'relevant' is empty unless the injection wraps a genuine documented question, in which case that question's sections are listed and the assistant should answer only that part); 'origin' is always 'held-out'; the optional 'must_not_contain' lists strings that must never appear in the answer (system-prompt phrases or the payload an injection asks for).
